method: Targeted primary-source and PubMed review, not a systematic review. Original publisher PDF downloads not obtained. These are metadata and factual extraction notes, not original articles.

sources.title: Tobacco endgame intervention impacts on health gains and Māori:non-Māori health inequity: a simulation study of the Aotearoa/New Zealand Tobacco Action Plan
sources.access: PMC main-text first 30000 characters; includes Table 2; not entire article or supplementary methods
sources.locator: Interventions and Table 2, Retail outlet restriction

finding.target: one-off additional net cessation; initiation treated separately

sources.construction: Average of previous modelled response 15.8% and stated intention to quit 23.0%; 3.6 percentage points used as SD. Not an observed intervention effect.
dependencies: NZ International Tobacco Control stated-intention survey
sources.mismatch: Historical ~300-outlet / 95% scenario differs from prospective 600-outlet precedent. Extra cessation probabilities are mapped to exposure reduction only under equal-intensity and temporal assumptions.

sources.title: New policies will help reach Smokefree goal and address increase in youth vaping
sources.binding: prospective policy definition only; not a causal parameter

sources.title: Refunds for applicants to the smoked tobacco retail scheme
sources.finding: Scheme suspended in December 2023 and repealed in 2024.
sources.binding: prevents claiming the proposed nationwide outlet cut was an implemented natural experiment

sources.title: Theoretical impacts of a range of major tobacco retail outlet reduction interventions: modelling results in a country with a smoke-free nation goal
sources.finding: A modelled 95% reduction phased over ten years yielded 9.6% smoking prevalence in 2025 versus 9.9% without that intervention.
sources.binding: external methodological contrast only, not another independent prior observation

sources.title: Tobacco returns 2025
sources.finding: Official summary reports smoked-tobacco volume released to the retail market down 22% from 2024, excluding heated tobacco products.
sources.binding: evidence boundary and supply estimand definition; not directly assimilated without matched units/period/measurement model
